subject: general
question: In November 2025, the Standing Committee of the National Board for Wildlife approved several defence and paramilitary projects in which of the following protected areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karakoram Wildlife Sanctuary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **November 2025**, the **Standing Committee of the National Board for Wildlife (SC-NBWL)** cleared several strategic **defence** and **paramilitary projects** specifically located within the **Karakoram Wildlife Sanctuary**.
 
• The sanctuary is situated in the **Leh district** of the Union Territory of **Ladakh**, representing a high-altitude cold desert ecosystem of immense **geopolitical** and **ecological** importance.
 
• These approvals include the construction of **strategic roads**, **border outposts**, and **telecommunication infrastructure** to be developed by the **Border Roads Organization (BRO)** and the **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Karakoram Wildlife Sanctuary.***
 
• The projects aim to strengthen India's surveillance and logistics capabilities along the **Line of Actual Control (LAC)**, ensuring better troop movement and communication in the difficult terrain of **Eastern Ladakh**.
 
• The **Standing Committee**, which functions under the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**, reviewed these proposals to balance **national security** requirements with the conservation needs of the region's unique biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Karakoram Wildlife Sanctuary**:
 
 
• Established in the year **1987**, it covers an area of over **5,000 square kilometers** in **Ladakh**.
 
• It is one of the few places in **India** where the rare **Chiru (Tibetan Antelope)** is found, which is known for its fine wool called **Shahtoosh**.
 
• The sanctuary also provides a habitat for other endangered species like the **Snow Leopard**, **Tibetan Gazelle**, and the **Himalayan Ibex**.
 
 
 
• **National Board for Wildlife (NBWL)**:
 
 
• It is a **statutory body** constituted under the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**.
 
• The **Prime Minister of India** serves as the **ex-officio chairperson** of the **NBWL**, while the **Union Minister of Environment** chairs the **Standing Committee**.
 
• It acts as an **advisory board** to the Central Government on framing policies and measures for **wildlife conservation**.
 
 
 
• **Other Protected Areas in Options**:
 
 
• **Dehing Patkai Wildlife Sanctuary**: Located in **Assam**, it is often referred to as the **"Amazon of the East"** due to its dense rainforest cover.
 
• **Khangchendzonga National Park**: Situated in **Sikkim**, it is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** recognized under the **"Mixed" category** for both natural and cultural significance.
 
• **Raimona National Park**: Declared as the **sixth national park** of **Assam** in **2021**, it is located in the **Kokrajhar district** and is famous for the **Golden Langur**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Infrastructure in Ladakh**:
 
 
• The government has accelerated **infrastructure development** in **Ladakh** following the **2020 border standoff** to ensure **all-weather connectivity**.
 
• The **720-km long** strategic roads and mobile towers are essential for the **Border Roads Organization (BRO)** to maintain supply lines to forward areas near the **Karakoram Pass**.
 
• **Wildlife clearances** are mandatory under **Section 29** and **Section 35** of the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972** for any non-forestry activity inside a sanctuary or national park.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Challenges**:
 
 
• Large-scale construction in **high-altitude** zones can impact **migratory corridors** of wildlife and delicate **permafrost** layers.
 
• The **SC-NBWL** often imposes conditions such as **compensatory afforestation** and the creation of **wildlife passages** to mitigate the environmental footprint of **defence projects**.
